title: Security Deposit Account Funding, Installment and Refundability Schedule
content:
This schedule sets, for each deposit program of the Security Deposit Account, when the deposit is due after lease approval, whether it may be paid in installments, which instruments are accepted, and whether amounts received are refundable or earn interest.

## Funding terms

| Program | Due within (calendar days after lease approval) | Held before move-in required | Installments allowed | Maximum installments, first included | Days between installments |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan | 3 | yes | no | 1 | 0 |
| Reduced Deposit Plan | 3 | yes | no | 1 | 0 |
| Standard Deposit Plan | 3 | yes | no | 1 | 0 |
| Premier Residence Deposit Plan | 3 | yes | no | 1 | 0 |
| Conditional Approval Deposit Plan | 2 | yes | yes | 3 | 30 |
| Enhanced Deposit Plan | 2 | yes | yes | 3 | 30 |

## Accepted funding instruments

| Program | Accepted instruments |
|---|---|
| Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan | one-time ACH bank debit, debit card, credit card |
| Reduced Deposit Plan | one-time ACH bank debit, money order, cashier's check |
| Standard Deposit Plan | one-time ACH bank debit, money order, cashier's check |
| Premier Residence Deposit Plan | one-time ACH bank debit, money order, cashier's check |
| Conditional Approval Deposit Plan | one-time ACH bank debit, money order, cashier's check |
| Enhanced Deposit Plan | one-time ACH bank debit, money order, cashier's check |

## Refundability and interest

| Program | Amounts received are refundable deposit | Additional pet deposits refundable on the same basis | Interest accrues on deposits held |
|---|---|---|---|
| Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan | no (the guarantee premium is not refundable) | yes | no |
| Reduced Deposit Plan | yes | yes | no |
| Standard Deposit Plan | yes | yes | no |
| Premier Residence Deposit Plan | yes | yes | no |
| Conditional Approval Deposit Plan | yes | yes | no |
| Enhanced Deposit Plan | yes | yes | no |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Conditional Approval Deposit Plan lease approved on the 1st of a month has its deposit, or its first installment, due within 2 calendar days, by the 3rd. With installments, at most 3 are allowed and each later one falls 30 calendar days after the previous one. A Standard Deposit Plan lease approved on the same day has its full deposit due within 3 calendar days, by the 4th.
